attributes.soundness_note: A SLOT DELTA IS ONLY A REGISTER PAIR ON A WORD wf_word_diff CLASSES `REGFIELD-ONLY`. The first draft of this census histogrammed every differing word and fabricated pairs on the two entries whose words are a permutation or an opcode difference -- sysPollResetButton's 2 OPCODE words produced six phantom 'renamings'. The shipped census skips every non-REGFIELD-ONLY word and reports the count it skipped instead; across the 41 that is 2 words in 1 pin. Anyone folding these into prose inherits that rule: the pairs are evidence for a renaming ONLY within the REGFIELD-ONLY subset, and B2's multi-target rows are not renamings at all until the per-offset view is read.

attributes.why_it_matters: The user mandate makes source-exhaustion provenance the EQUIVALENT tier's admission ticket, and a pin with no mechanism is the shape a provenance audit cannot check: it states that a rule exists, not what it closes. These 41 are 27% of the 154 shipped rules. The sketches here do not supply PROVENANCE -- that is the separate 14-rule repair item WP leads this run -- they supply the MECHANISM half, which is what a later lane needs to decide whether a source form could delete the rule under the standing promotion directive. Six of the 41 are already cheap promotion candidates on size alone: sysClearFlags (4 insns, 2 words), MissileCollideEnemy (4), InitAnim (4), DmgFxAdd (4), gendir_8004FBC8 (5 words), dbgTextInit (6 insns, 5 words) and add_vmu_file (5 words).

subject: project:gdl
value:
MECHANISM SKETCHES FOR THE 41 MECHANISM-LESS WEBFRANK PINS, derived at c0f978273, handed to claude-fleet-worker-WP to fold into config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json (WP owns that file this run; this lane edited nothing). CENSUS FIRST, because the number has been quoted without one: config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json holds 154 rule entries over 52 units; 113 carry a `mechanism` string and 41 carry NONE. There is no middle: the shortest present mechanism is over 120 characters, so 'mechanism-less' is a clean binary, 41 exactly, matching T21 item 6.

TRIAGE OF THE WORK ORDER'S PREMISE -- PARTLY REFUTED. The order says 'a permutation's atoms or a recolor's field map IS a mechanism sketch', i.e. decode the rule's own JSON. That works for FOUR of the 41 and for none of the other 37, because the 37 carry `copy_register_fields: true` -- a BARE BOOLEAN with no field map anywhere in the file. Measured over all 154 entries, `copy_register_fields` is of type bool 134 times and of no other type ever; the structured classes are instruction_permutation (list 23, dict 40), equivalent_copy_form (list 30), value_equality_recolor (dict 9), post_recolor_permutation (list 3 / dict 1), register_fields (list 2), recolors (list 1). So the rule body is DERIVED AT APPLY TIME for the copy_register_fields class and the JSON cannot be decoded into a mechanism. The 37 are still derivable -- but from the RAW BODY, not from the config: `wf_word_diff.py <unit> <fn> --list` prints every differing word as an O/T pair, and the register-slot delta between the two words IS the field map. That is how the sketches below were produced.

CATEGORY A -- MECHANISM DECODABLE FROM THE RULE'S OWN JSON (4):
  game/g3d/sndvoice::sndVoiceUpdateAll  json=recolors
  game/sys/ml_mem::AllocFile  json=instruction_permutation
  game/audio/mempool::pool_garbage_collect  json=unproven_recolor_audit
  game/sys/sysservice::sysPollResetButton  json=instruction_permutation
    sndVoiceUpdateAll: `recolors` is an EXPLICIT two-window field map -- [0x9f8,0xb3c) gpr {7:8} and [0xb3c,0xb5c) gpr {7:8, 8:9}. That IS the mechanism prose, verbatim, and the raw read agrees: 42 differing words, all REGFIELD-ONLY, histogram r7->r8 x45 and r8->r9 x4.
    AllocFile and sysPollResetButton: `instruction_permutation` declares start/end/order plus four hashes each -- AllocFile [0x6c,0x74) order [1,0], sysPollResetButton [0x88,0x90) order [1,0], both audit SCHEDULE_CANDIDATE with permuted_instructions 2. A two-instruction swap at a named offset is a complete mechanism sentence. NOTE for whoever writes it: the raw word rows for a permuted pair must NOT be decoded as a renaming -- AllocFile's 2 words yield four apparent 'pairs' (r5->r6, r25->r29, r6->r5, r29->r25) that are one instruction swap, and sysPollResetButton's 2 words are classed OPCODE and yield none at all.
    pool_garbage_collect: already carries a 2,000-character `unproven_recolor_audit` that is a full mechanism derivation (the +0x30 `mr rD,r0` value-assignment difference, both machine refusals quoted, and a whole-function four-web bijection). It is mechanism-less only in the sense that the text sits under the wrong key. The cheapest correct action is to point `mechanism` at it, not to rewrite it.

CATEGORY B -- 37 pins whose JSON says only `copy_register_fields: true`. Sketch per pin below, all from the raw body: `insns` and `w` are wf_word_diff's instruction count and DIFFERING WORDS, every word REGFIELD-ONLY and MNEMONIC DIVERGENCE 0 unless noted, and `pairs` is the register-slot delta histogram over those words (a pair counted once per differing slot, so the totals exceed w on multi-slot words). B1 = the 26 pins whose source registers are all DISTINCT, i.e. the histogram is a candidate RENAMING and the mechanism sentence writes itself; B2 = the 11 where one source register maps to two or more targets, i.e. a rotation or a live-range split, and the sentence needs the per-offset rows (regenerate with --list) before it can be written honestly.
